tips.title: 伸展前先熱身

zh-Hant: 肌肉還沒熱開時直接伸展比較容易拉傷，所以可以先輕鬆走一走，等身體暖了再開始。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says stretching cold muscles can cause injury, and suggests 5 to 10 minutes of light walking, jogging, or biking first.

tips.title: 運動後適合做靜態伸展

zh-Hant: 想做停在同一個姿勢的靜態伸展，可以排在運動後，趁肌肉還暖的時候做。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says it is even better to stretch after a workout when muscles are warm, and not to treat stretching as the warmup.

tips.title: 衝刺前先別做靜態伸展

zh-Hant: 準備衝刺時，先把肌肉拉長並停在同一個姿勢，可能讓接下來的衝刺表現稍微變差。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic reports that holding a lengthened stretch immediately before a sprint may slightly worsen performance, and that stretching immediately before an event weakens hamstring strength.

tips.title: 伸展今天用得多的部位

zh-Hant: 挑伸展動作時，可以先想想今天哪些部位用得最多，像是跑步後就可以多照顧腿部。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says to stretch muscles and joints you routinely use, and that some evidence supports stretches for the muscles used most in a sport or activity.

tips.title: 伸展時保持呼吸

zh-Hant: 伸展到有拉感的位置後，可以停留約 30 秒，過程中維持平常的呼吸節奏。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says to breathe normally and hold each stretch for about 30 seconds.

tips.title: 特別緊的部位可以多停一下

zh-Hant: 有些特別緊的部位可能需要伸展約 60 秒，可以在有拉感但不痛的範圍內多停一會兒。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says problem areas may need a hold of around 60 seconds.

tips.title: 柔軟度需要持續維持

zh-Hant: 伸展練出來的關節活動範圍，可能在停練一段時間後縮小，所以想維持原本的幅度就要持續練習。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says range of motion gained from stretching may decrease again if stretching stops.

tips.title: 柔軟度也能在移動中練

zh-Hant: 太極、皮拉提斯或瑜伽的緩慢動作，可以讓身體練習在移動中伸展，改善特定動作的柔軟度。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic says gentle movements such as tai chi, Pilates, or yoga can improve flexibility in specific movements and can also help reduce falls in older adults.

tips.title: 用慢速版的動作熱身

zh-Hant: 動態熱身可以從接下來要做的動作開始，例如跑步前先用慢跑讓身體適應。

tips.provenance: Mayo Clinic describes a dynamic warmup as movements similar to the planned activity, started at a low level and then sped up with added intensity.

tips.title: 脊椎本來就有三個彎

zh-Hant: 頸部、上背和下背各有自然的弧度，坐著或站著時可以保留這些弧度，避免刻意把腰拱得更深。

tips.provenance: MedlinePlus says the spine has three natural curves, at the neck, mid back, and low back, and that posture should maintain those curves without increasing them.

tips.title: 坐久了可以換個姿勢

zh-Hant: 長時間彎腰垮坐可能讓脖子、肩膀和背部不舒服，坐久了可以起來動一動，再換個姿勢坐。

tips.provenance: MedlinePlus lists slouching as able to cause neck, shoulder, and back pain, decrease flexibility, and affect how well joints move. Stronger claims on the same list were not used.

tips.title: 坐著時讓椅背托住下背

zh-Hant: 坐著時可以把臀部坐到椅子後方，讓椅背支撐整個背部，尤其是下背自然往內彎的地方。

tips.provenance: MedlinePlus says the back should be fully supported, using a pillow or other support if the chair cannot support the lower-back curve.

tips.title: 打字時把肩膀放鬆

zh-Hant: 打字時可以讓肩膀自然放鬆，避免為了坐挺而一直用力把肩膀往後拉。

tips.provenance: MedlinePlus says shoulders should be relaxed, not rounded or pulled backwards, and elbows kept close and bent between 90 and 120 degrees.

tips.title: 運動強度會影響每週目標

zh-Hant: 一般成人的每週活動目標是至少 150 分鐘中等強度活動，例如快走，或 75 分鐘高強度活動，例如跑步。

tips.provenance: NHS adult page sets out 150 minutes moderate or 75 minutes vigorous, and says 75 minutes of vigorous activity can give similar health benefits to 150 minutes of moderate activity.

tips.title: 把活動分散到一週幾天

zh-Hant: 如果目標是一週做 150 分鐘中等強度活動，可以分散到四、五天，讓每次要做的時間短一點。

tips.provenance: NHS says to spread exercise evenly over 4 to 5 days a week, or every day.

tips.title: 用能不能唱歌判斷強度

zh-Hant: 活動時如果呼吸變快，還能聊天但唱不了歌，通常已經達到中等強度。

tips.provenance: NHS describes moderate effort as being able to talk but not sing, and vigorous effort as being unable to say more than a few words without pausing.

tips.title: 同一種活動也能調整強度

zh-Hant: 活動的強度取決於你有多吃力，例如騎同一台腳踏車時，加速或改騎上坡都會提高強度。

tips.provenance: NHS says most moderate activities can become vigorous if you increase your effort, and lists walking up stairs and fast or uphill cycling among vigorous examples.

tips.title: 用一點活動打斷久坐

zh-Hant: 如果已經坐著工作或看電視很久，可以起身走一走，用一小段活動打斷長時間不動。

tips.provenance: NHS adult guidelines say to reduce time spent sitting or lying down and to break up long periods of not moving with some activity.

tips.title: 肌力和有氧各有活動目標

zh-Hant: 每週 150 分鐘的中等強度有氧目標，可以用快走或騎車來累積，肌力訓練的時間另外計算。

tips.provenance: NHS says time spent on strength exercises does not count toward moderate aerobic activity, while walking or cycling does.

tips.title: 用最後一下感覺肌力負荷

zh-Hant: 做一組肌力動作時，如果到了最後，再多做一下已經覺得很吃力，就可以把它當成負荷夠不夠的參考。

tips.provenance: NHS says a strengthening exercise should be performed until another repetition would be difficult without help.

tips.title: 肌力訓練的一組怎麼算

zh-Hant: 做肌力訓練時，同一個動作連續做 8 到 12 下，可以算作一組。

tips.provenance: NHS says 8 to 12 repetitions count as one set, to do at least two sets, and that three sets give still more benefit. Build up over weeks.

tips.title: 肌力訓練可以用組數來安排

zh-Hant: 肌力和柔軟度練習沒有固定的分鐘數目標，安排肌力訓練時，可以用動作和組數規劃每次要做的量。

tips.provenance: NHS says there are no specific recommendations for how much time to spend on strength and flexibility exercises.

tips.title: 成人每週活動量有一段範圍

zh-Hant: 以中等強度的有氧活動為例，成人每週可以累積 150 到 300 分鐘，例如把快走分散在幾天完成。

tips.provenance: MedlinePlus says adults should get at least 150 to 300 minutes of moderate-intensity or 75 to 150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity a week.

tips.title: 通勤和休息也會累積久坐

zh-Hant: 工作、通勤和休息時坐著的時間都會累加，不少成人一天坐著超過 7 小時。

tips.provenance: NHS cites research that many adults spend more than 7 hours a day sitting, and that people over 65 spend 10 hours or more a day sitting or lying down.

tips.title: 活動後可能暫時沒那麼焦慮

zh-Hant: 對成人來說，做完一次中等到高強度的身體活動後，短時間內可能會感覺比較不焦慮。

tips.provenance: CDC says reduced short-term feelings of anxiety for adults can follow a session of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity.

tips.title: 規律活動也能幫大腦維持功能

zh-Hant: 規律的身體活動有助於維持思考、學習和判斷能力，也和較低的憂鬱及焦慮風險有關。

tips.provenance: CDC says regular physical activity can help keep thinking, learning, and judgment skills sharp, reduce the risk of depression and anxiety, and help sleep.

tips.title: 活動量和心血管健康有關

zh-Hant: 每週累積至少 150 分鐘中等強度活動，例如快走，和較低的心臟病及中風風險有關。

tips.provenance: CDC says at least 150 minutes a week of moderate activity is linked with lower heart-disease and stroke risk, more activity lowers risk further, and regular activity can lower blood pressure and improve cholesterol.

tips.title: 活動量還沒達標也可能有益

zh-Hant: 即使每週還做不到 150 分鐘，規律的中等強度活動也可能有助於降低第二型糖尿病和代謝症候群的風險。

tips.provenance: CDC says people can start to benefit from even less than 150 minutes a week of moderate activity for type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome risk, with more activity lowering risk further.

tips.title: 身體活動和部分癌症風險有關

zh-Hant: 保持身體活動和至少八種癌症的風險較低有關，其中包括大腸癌與乳癌。

tips.provenance: CDC says being physically active lowers risk for at least eight cancers, and that for survivors regular activity supports quality of life and physical fitness.

tips.title: 練肌力有助於維持肌肉

zh-Hant: 肌力訓練有助於維持肌肉量和力量，對隨年齡增長而逐漸流失肌肉的人尤其重要。

tips.provenance: CDC says muscle-strengthening can increase or maintain muscle mass and strength, and to slowly increase weight and repetitions.

tips.title: 年長者防跌可以搭配三種活動

zh-Hant: 年長者可以把有氧、肌力和平衡練習搭配起來，例如快走、從椅子起身和練習站穩，以降低跌倒風險。

tips.provenance: CDC says older adults need aerobic, muscle-strengthening, and balance activities together to improve function and decrease fall risk. Stretching alone is not the listed mix.

tips.title: 快走是中等強度活動的一種

zh-Hant: 快走時呼吸會比散步時快，對多數人來說，這是安全的中等強度活動。

tips.provenance: CDC says moderate physical activity, such as brisk walking, is generally safe for most people.

tips.title: 每週的運動分鐘數可以分段累積

zh-Hant: 如果找不到完整的 30 分鐘快走，可以把時間分成早、中、晚各 10 分鐘，合計仍是 30 分鐘。

tips.provenance: CDC says 150 minutes can be 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week, and can be broken into smaller chunks.

tips.title: 不同活動練到不同能力

zh-Hant: 安排年長者的運動時，可以讓快走、肌力和平衡練習輪流出現，分別照顧耐力、力量和站立時的穩定度。

tips.provenance: NIA says it is important to get aerobic, muscle-strengthening, and balance exercise, and that variety helps reduce boredom and injury risk.

tips.title: 同一肌群的訓練日可以隔開

zh-Hant: 大肌群可以每週訓練至少兩天，安排時把練同一組肌肉的日子隔開，例如週一和週三練腿。

tips.provenance: NIA says to do muscle-strengthening at least two days a week, but not to work the same muscle group on two days in a row.

tips.title: 練肌力時保持呼吸

zh-Hant: 做肌力動作時容易不自覺憋氣，可以跟著動作的節奏呼吸，讓氣息保持順暢。

tips.provenance: NIA says not to hold the breath during strength exercises: breathe out during the effort and in as you relax.

tips.title: 平衡練習可以分散到一週三天

zh-Hant: 年長者可以把平衡練習安排在每週約三天，讓維持身體穩定成為固定練習。

tips.provenance: NIA says to aim for about three sessions of balance exercises a week, and that balance exercises help prevent falls and fall-related injuries.

tips.title: 日常生活也有活動機會

zh-Hant: 做家事、走路去辦事或騎車代步都算身體活動，可以從平常就會做的事增加活動量。

tips.provenance: NIA says activity can be chores, errands, walking or biking for transportation, or leisure, and that variety may reduce overuse injury risk.

tips.title: 把活動排在最有精神的時候

zh-Hant: 如果你早上比晚上有精神，可以把散步排在早上，讓運動配合自己一天的體力變化。

tips.provenance: NIA says to plan activity for the parts of the day when you feel most energetic, and that many older adults feel less fatigue during and after activity.

tips.title: 吃力的運動前留時間熱身

zh-Hant: 準備做較吃力的運動時，可以先留至少 6 分鐘做熱身，從原地踏步這類輕鬆的動作開始。

tips.provenance: NHS says this warm-up should take at least 6 minutes, longer if needed, and to stop immediately if you feel pain or become unwell.

tips.title: 熱身是為了準備接下來的運動

zh-Hant: 一般的全身熱身是為了讓身體準備接下來的運動，有特定部位疼痛時，適合的活動方式要視原因而定。

tips.provenance: NHS says the exercises are general and not aimed at treating a specific cause of pain, and to get advice first if unsure, unwell, injured, recently after a heart attack or operation, pregnant, or recently after birth.

tips.title: 曾跌倒的人可以練力量和平衡

zh-Hant: 如果曾經跌倒或擔心跌倒，可以把肌力、平衡和柔軟度練習放進活動安排，幫助自己更有力、站得更穩。

tips.provenance: NHS older-adult guidance says if you have fallen or are worried about falling, strength, balance, and flexibility exercises will help you feel stronger and more confident. The same page says to speak to a GP if you have not exercised for some time or have medical concerns.
